topic: Yohei Nishitsuji Macroscopic microscope source, GLSL semantics and license boundary

sources.kind: author-authored article embedding the author's X post
observedFacts: The displayed Macroscopic microscope expression contains log2(R=length(p))-2.-t*.3, -p.z/R, atan(p.x,p.y), s=1, s<1e5, s+=s and a contribution divided by s.
The article rendering substitutes typographic dashes in at least two places, so it is not a byte-exact compilable lock of the original post.
The author describes the work as a minimal-character GLSL artwork about continuity across scales; he does not state that its exact octave schedule is a universal material model.
The portfolio identifies macroscopic microscope as a 265-character work and links to an X post.
No software license for the linked artwork was observed on the portfolio page.
sources.lockStrength: current public page; no source archive

observedFacts: The two-argument signature is atan(y, x); signs select the quadrant and atan(0,0) is undefined.
Pre-decrement subtracts 1 or 1.0 and yields the modified value.
Codrops says downloadable demos are MIT unless stated otherwise.
Codrops allows article excerpts but asks that entire articles not be republished.
The Macroscopic microscope item is an embedded author X post, not an identified Codrops downloadable demo in the audited article.
sources.licenseConclusion: No explicit license for copying, adapting or redistributing the author's shader was found; status Unknown, not MIT by inference.

independence.OR-R67-YOHEI-CODROPS_and_OR-R67-YOHEI-PO: same author lineage; not independent empirical roots
independence.OR-R67-CODROPS-LICENSE: publisher policy root; scope does not grant a license to the embedded author work
